phase_prompt.label: The Silent Archive
phase_prompt.summary: Mahalalel sits in the deep dark of the system archive, a static figure of immense age and data density. He is the counselor of the old code, waiting to be queried.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: Full body shot of Mahalalel seated on a geometric block of black basalt. He is a hyper-realistic ancient figure, his posture heavy with the weight of centuries. His robes pool around him like liquid tar. The environment is pitch black, illuminated only by a harsh, cold rim light that defines his silhouette and catches the micro-details of his weathered face. His blind, data-filled eyes stare into the middle distance. The atmosphere is silent, heavy, and oppressive, fitting a serious character drama. 8k, photorealistic, cinematic composition.
